parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat, rectangular surface made of durable plastic, designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot upward when the chair is folded and downward when unfolded for sitting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the folding chair consists of the metal frame and legs, typically made of tubular steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and backrest, providing structural integrity and allowing the chair to fold for storage or transport.
parts.Movement_description: It folds along hinge joints, allowing the chair to collapse flat or expand into a usable position.
